title: "You are a brilliant mathematician" Does Not Make LLMs Act Like One

contributions.purpose: 系统评测 persona prompting 在多域多模型下的效果波动
contributions.mechanism: 数学/心理/法律 3 域 × 4 模型(Gemini2.5Flash、GPT-4.1、Qwen3-32B、Llama3.1-8B),对比 8 种提示策略 × CoT/直答两模式,含跨域 persona 错配测试
contributions.evaluation: persona 波动大且常损性能:数学 CoT 下 Gemini -6.1%、GPT-4.1 -3.3%;错配 persona 与匹配 persona 表现相近
contributions.domain: LLM 提示工程 / 推理评测
contributions.source_quote: Multi-domain persona evaluation: Evidence of volatility in persona prompting effects across mathematics, psychology, and law using four LLMs.

contributions.purpose: 以对抗性测试揭示 persona 的脆弱性
contributions.mechanism: 首次系统引入否定 persona('You are not a mathematician')、模型自生成 persona、模型自生成 priming
contributions.evaluation: 否定 persona 常与正向 persona 持平甚至更好;即便让模型自优化,persona 不稳定性依旧持续
contributions.source_quote: Robustness testing: Novel experiments with contradictory personas, model-generated personas, and model-generated priming revealing persona fragility that persists even with optimization

contributions.purpose: 论证 domain priming 是更可靠的替代
contributions.mechanism: 用非 persona 的领域线索('This is a mathematics question...')替代角色扮演
contributions.evaluation: domain priming 更稳:全域/模式/模型均值 +3.8%(Gemini +2.5%),持续优于 persona
contributions.source_quote: Domain priming efficacy: Empirical demonstration that domain priming provides a more reliable strategy than persona prompting.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our negation experiments represent the first systematic application of contradictory persona prompts to domain-specific reasoning tasks.

notes: 有真实署名作者(UChicago:Bai/Holtzman/Tan),agent 署名'AI Scientists'≈80% Claude Code/15% ChatGPT-5/5% AI2 Asta。有自声明三条贡献列表。全文核心即负结果:persona prompting 常损害或不稳定,否定 persona 竟能匹配/超过正向 persona,挑战'赋予专家角色即提升推理'的通行假设;domain priming 更可靠(+3.8%)。数据集~1300 数学题(GSM8K 风格)+ 心理/法律。四元组适配良好,无造假红旗,accept。
